description: Mu kiganiro giheruka twumvise ubuhanuzi bwa Zekariya yeretswe yuko Yerusalemu hazosubira kwubakwa. Ubwo buhanuzi buvuga kubizoba mu gihe c'ubwami bwa Kristo bwo mu gihe kizoza igihe azoza gushinga ingoma yiwe mw'isi. Niho rero ubwiza bwiwe buzobana n'Ab'Isirayeli kandi bakaba mu mahoro ntangere.
name: I Yerusalemu hasubira kwubakwa

description: Twihweje imirongo yo mu gice ca 12,ivuga ku bibi bizoba mu gihe c'iherezo. Twarumvise yuko kuva mu gice ca 12 gushika mu gice ca 14 c'igitabu ca Zekariya havugwamwo ibibi n'ivyiza bizoba mu gihe c'iherezo. Ivyo bibi bikaba ari ibizoba mu gihe c'amagogwa ishengero ry'Imana rimaze kuva mw'isi.
name: Ibibi bizoba

description: Twaganiriye ku bihe bigoye bizoza mu gihe ca Antikristo. Ico gihe ngo amahanga yose azokoranywa n'ukugwanya Yerusalemu ariko ico gisagara kizotuma Imana icira urubanza ayo mahana.
name: Ibibi bizoba mu gihe c'iherezo

description: Twaganiriye kubizoba mu gihe c'iherezo twisunze ivyanditswe mu gice ca 14 mu gitabu ca Zekariya. Twabonye ko harimwo amajambo y'ubuhanuzi yerekana integuro y'Imana ku bantu bayo.
name: Ibizoba mu gihe c'iherezo

description: Twarumvise ingene Imana yagabishije abantu bayo kuvyo gusenga ibigigwamana no kuvyo gufata minenerwe ijambo ryayo. Imana iravuga ko itazoreka guhana abungere babi babura bagakora nabi bakabura kuyoborera intama zayo mw'ijambo ryayo bakaziroha mu vyo gusenga ibigigwamana.
name: Ibizoba mu gihe kizoza

description: Twaraginje igitabu ca Zekariya twumvise ubuhanuzi bwinshi bw'ibizoba mu gihe c'iherezo. Imana igomba ko wewe nanje tuba abejejwe.Twahamagariwe kwezwa no gutungana kugira tuzoshike mw'ijuru.
name: Ibizokurikira ukuza kwa Yesu

description: Twumvise ukuntu Imana yasezeranye kuzokwama ishinze ijisho ku gisagara ca Yerusalemu kugira ngo no mugihe c'iherezo ntihazogwe mu minwe y'abansi.
name: Imana isezerana kwambika inkomezi Abayuda

description: Twaganiriye ku kuntu Imana yasezeraniye Ab'Isirayeli intinzi ariko imbere yaho bagaca mu makuba menshi kubera ugutera akagere Uhoraho. Mu mirongo itangura igice ca 11, yari imburi ibereka ko bagiye gutegwa n'umwasi agasambura igisagara ca Yerusalemu.
name: Imana isezeranira Ab'Isirayeli intsinzi

description: Twumvise ivyo Zekariya yeretswe bijanye n'ibizoba mu gihe c'iherezo. Zekariya yabwiwe kwambika ibitsibo Yosuwa.
name: Impera zizohabwa abagororotsi

description: Twabonye ivy'inganji yasezeraniwe Abayuda. Kristo Yesu niwe buye rigumya imfuruka, niwe yaje guhuza abo mu muryango wa Yuda abagira umwe n'abo muyindi miryango .
name: Inganji yasezeraniwe Abayuda

description: Twarabiye hamwe ivyerekeye ukwisonzesha Imana idashima, ikindi twabonye
name: Ingene Ab'Isirayeli bagararije Imana

description: Twumvise ingene Ab'Isirayeli kubera ko batitondeye ijambo ry'Imana , babaye nk'umukuku w'imbagwa nukuvuga ko Imana yabarekuriye k'umwansi akabatera bakicwa abandi bagasabagirizwa mu mahanga menshi yo mw'isi.
name: Ingene Ab'Isirayeli bahavuye baba imbagwa

description: Twihweje ubuhanuzi buvuga yuko Yerusalemu hazosubira kwubakwa nk'uko tubibona mu gice ca 2 c'igitabu ca Zekariya. Ubwo buhanuzi buvuga ku bizoba mu gihe c'iherezo aho Yesu Kristo azogarukira kuganza isi yose mu mahoro ico gihe Imana izokwegeranya Ab'Isirayeli ibakuye mu mahanga yose iyo bazoba barasabagiriye ibakoranirize ku murwa wayo Yerusalemu. Imana iravuga ko ariyo yasabagije ab'Isirayeli mu mahanga kubera ibigabitanyo vyabo, ariko yuko itazokwigera ireka kubakunda.
name: Ingene Imana izokwegeranya Ab'Isirayeli

description: Twarabiye hamwe ingene vyagenze igihe Zekariya yeretswe Yosuwa umuherezi mukuru. Zekariya yeretswe Yosuwa ahagaze imbere y'umumalayika w'Uhoraho yambaye impuzu z'ubuhoma satani nawe yari ahagaze iburyo bwa Yosuwa ngo amurege vyumvikana yuko atari abereye guhagarara imbere y'Imana nk'umuherezi mukuru. Ariko mu nyuma uwo mumalayika w'uhoraho yaciye amukura za mpuzu z'ubuhoma amwambika izishajije aramubwira ati raba ngukuyeko ukugabitanya kwawe. Ukwo niko Umwami Yesu Kristo yahanaguye ibigabitanyo vy'abamwizeye kugira ngo bashobore guhagarara imbere y'Imana badatsindwa.
name: Ingene vyagenze Zekariya yeretswe Yosuwa

description: Twihweje ingene Yerusalemu kizoba igisagara gihambaye aho Kristo azogarukira akakigira umugwa mukuru w'ubwami bwiwe mw'isi yose.
name: Ingene Yerusalemu hazoba agakomeye

description: Twarabiye hamwe ingorane zizoba kubigira abavugishwa n'Imana. Bazomaramara, batinye nukuvuga ivyo barose kuko bazobona yuko bitari ivy'ukuri mbere abavugishwa b'ibinyoma bazobona ko bakwiye kuva muvy'ubuvugishwa bakitwararika ibikorwa bindi vy'amaboko.
name: Ingorane zizoba kubigira abavugishwa n'Imana

description: Twarumvise yuko Ab'Isirayeli mu gihe ca Zekariya , batewe umwikomo nuko bamaze imyaka myinshi bisonzesha ariko Imana ntibibabare.
name: Inyishu Imana yahaye Ab'Isirayeli

description: Twarabiye hamwe amajambo avuga ku gihe c'iherezo aho Yesu azoza gushinga ingoma yiwe y'ubwami bw'amahoro mw'isi .Igitabu ca Zekariya tumazemwo iminsi ni ic'ubuhanuzi bw'ibizoba muri kazoza.Kuva Zekariya yeretswe vyinshi bizoba hari bimwe bimwe bimaze gushika n'ibindi bikiri mw'ibanaga.
name: Ivy'igice c'iherezo

description: Twarabiye hamwe ivy'imikogote ine Zekariya yeretswe iturutse hagati y'imisozi ibiri kandi iyo misozi yari imiringa. Ababinonosoye bavuga ko iyo misozi ibiri yoba ari umusozi wa Siyoni n'umusozi wa Elayono.
name: Ivy'imikogote ine

description: Mu kiganiro giheruka twarumvise ingene abantu b'I Beteri batumye ababaserukira babo babiri ngo baje I Yerusalemu mu mu rusengero ngo bavugane n'abaherezi ivy'ukwisonzesha, ko ukwo kwisonzesha kwabo kwemewe?
name: Ivy'ukwisonzesha

description: Twaganiriye k'umuzingo w'igitabo Zekariya yeretswe, abonye uwo muzingo w'igitabo uguruka ngo yaciye abaza uwo mumalayika bariko baravugana ngo amubwire ico bivuga ko ari umuvumo urekuwe ngo ukwire isi yose.
name: Ivy'umuzingo w'igitabo uguruka

description: Twabonye ingene Imana yabibukije ko igikuru yabagombako kwari ukwumva no kwitondera amajambo y'abavugishwa nayo.
name: Ivyo Imana yagomba ku bantu bayo

description: Twaganiriye kuvyo Zekariya yeretswe mu kwezi kwa 11 ngo abishikirize Ab'Isirayeli. Ni ca gihe yerekwa umuntu agendera kw'ifarasi y'akagajo ahagaze hagati y"ibiti vy'imihadasi vyo mu gasoko . Ivyo twarabisomye muri Zekariya 1 : 8 , twasanze uwo muntu yariko aragendera ku ndogoba y'akagajo yari Umwami Yesu yariko aragendagenda yitegereza isi ataraza kuyivukiramwo, ako kagajo n'ibara ritukura ritwigisha kuvy'amaraso Umwami yaviriye muri iyi si kubw'ivyaha vy'abari mw'iyi si.
name: Ivyo Zekariya yeretswe

description: Twarabiye hamwe ivyo Zekariya yeretswe vyerekeye Yosuwa umuherezi mukuru . Uwo muherezi mukuru. Uwo muherezi mukuru yabonetse ahagaze imbere y'umumalayika w'Uhoraho satani nawe ahagaze iruhande yiwe agira ngo amurege ariko uwo mumalayika w'uhoraho yari uwo kumugwanirira, aravuga ati Uhoraho yirobanuriye Yerusalemu aguhane .
name: Ivyo Zekariya yeretswe kuri Yosuwa

description: Twihweje ingene Yerusalemu kizoba igisagara gihambaye aho Kristo azogarukira akakigira umugwa mukuru w'ubwami bwiwe mw'isi yose.
name: ubuhanuzi bw'imburi kuyandi mahanga

description: Twarabiye hamwe ubuhanuzi bw'imburi ku mahanga yari ahereranye na Isirayeli mu gihe c'uwavugishwa n'Imana Zekariya .Ayo mahanga yarimwo ibisagara bitunze cane bimwe vya Tiro ,Sidoni, Damasiko n'ibindi harimwo n'ivyo mu bihugu vy'Ubufirisitiya Imana rero yari yamaramaje kubangurira ukuboko kwayo Ubufilisitiya ngo isangangure ibigigwamana vyaho.
name: Ubuhanuzi bw'imburi kuyandi mahanga

description: Twaganiriye kuvyo Zekariya yeretswe bijanye n'amatara y'izahabu n'ibiti bibiri vy'imyerayo. Ivyo Zekariya yeretswe rero nk'uko twabibonye muri ico gice ca 4 bwari ubutumwa bwo kuremesha Zerubaberi n'Ab'Isirayeli baheruka kuva mu kinyago ngo bamenye ko Imana izobana nabo mu gikorwa bahawe co gusubira kwubaka urusengero.
name: Umumalayika abaza Zekariya

description: Ukugaruka kwa Yesu Kristo, kwavuzweko vyinshi. Ibimenyetso vyinshi vyari vyaravuzwe vyaratanguye kuboneka. Abamwizeye basabwa kwitegura.
name: Yesu azogaruka nk'uko Isezerano ryiwe riri.

description: Twihweje ikintu canyuma muvyo Zekariya yeretswe nk uko tuibibona mu bice bitandatu vya mbere. Imana yashishikaye kuremesha Ab'Isirayeli
name: Yosuwa yambikwa ibitsibo

description: Twaganiririye kuvyo uwavugishwa n'Imana Zekariya yeretswe mu kwezi kw'I 11 mu mwaka ugira 2 Dariyo ari kungoma , aho yeretswe Umwami Yesu yariko aritegereza isi mu gihe atari bwaze kuyivukiramwo . Ibindi Zekariya n'amahembe ane n'abacuzi bane insiguro y'ivyo vyose ngo n'ubwami bune buhambaye bwari ubwa banyamahanga bwasabagije abantu b'Imana b'Ab'Isirayeli. Ubwo bwami bwose kugira ngo busubire hasi Imana yagiye ishiraho ubundi bwo kubuca ivutu. Ariko kuvy'ubwami bw'Abaroma twarumvise ko bwasubijwe hasi n'ivyaha vyo muri bwo nyene .
name: Zekariya abandanya kwerekwa

description: Twarabiye hamwe ivy'ibiterekwako amatara n'ibiti bibiri vy'imyerayo Zekariya yeretswe (Zekariya4:2 ). Igiterekwako amatara kuva na kera cahoze mw'ihema ry'Imana hanyuma gishigwa mu rusengero rwayo nuyu musi rero ico nikimwe mu bimenyetso vy'akarangamutima vy'ihanga rya Isirayeli. Igiterekwako amatara gisobanugwa ngo Umwami Yesu Kristo nayo amatara arimwo amavuta ni mpwemu Yera .
name: Zekariya yerekwa ivy'amatara
